title: Canine PeptideAtlas 2024-01 (build 573): peptides, PSM counts per sample and protein calls

sources.access_terms: Ensembl data: no restrictions on use or redistribution; attribute Ensembl

upstream.access_terms: Ensembl data: no restrictions on use or redistribution; attribute Ensembl

coverage.accession: PeptideAtlas build 573 (Canis familiaris 2024-01); raw data PXD052932
coverage.search: Comet 2023.01 and MSFragger 4.0 against UniProt UP000805418 (one protein per gene), Ensembl ROS_Cfam_1.0 and contaminants, with Trans-Proteomic Pipeline validation, per the deposit
coverage.breed_source: The deposit's SDRF (PXD052932) for the 108 tissue runs; the article for all samples, including plasma and urine
coverage.target_resolution: peptide: the unmodified amino-acid sequence, with PSM counts per sample; protein: PeptideAtlas protein calls for the whole build
coverage.peptide_locations: Each mapping's locations are [protein, start, end, chromosome, strand, chromosome_start, chromosome_end, exact], 1-based and inclusive; chromosome fields are null for UniProt entries, and exact is false where the protein has isoleucine for leucine or the reverse, which PeptideAtlas maps as equal
coverage.peptide_counts: PSMs per peptide in each search batch where it was observed, from peptide_instance_search_batch.tsv; PeptideAtlas sums modified forms and charge states
coverage.protein_counting: A protein's PSMs include shared peptides, so they don't sum to the build's PSMs
coverage.ensembl_mapping: Proteins map to Ensembl 110 by identical full-length sequence; all 25,710 Ensembl proteins in the search set are identical in Ensembl 105-111
coverage.nc_orf_search: not performed: canonical protein databases only
coverage.web_summary: PeptideAtlas's page reports 245,884 distinct peptides and 13,716,253 PSMs; its export holds 149,546 peptides, 197,285 distinct modified sequences and 13,781,115 PSMs
coverage.measurement_limits: PSM counts; no copies per cell or normalization across samples

operations: keep per-sample PSM counts for every peptide
check every peptide location against its protein sequence
keep the build's protein calls, presence levels and PSM counts
map called UniProt and Ensembl proteins to Ensembl 110 by identical sequence
